data.case_title: Wardrobe delivery and assembly appointment (Beispielwohnen Lieferservice)
data.explanation: Beispielwohnen Lieferservice has scheduled the delivery and assembly of your wardrobe "Nordsee" for Saturday, 12 December 2026, starting at 08:00 and taking about three hours. Make sure the spot where the wardrobe will stand is clear and that the delivery team can park close to the house. If this date does not suit you, call the company at least three working days before the appointment to reschedule; the app shows the latest call-back date. No payment is requested in this letter.
